results.composition_analysis: Full 74-field directory and derived/nondeclared section agree with WP06: time queries are callable lazy readers, not new persistent fields or new UI; negative T-L and integer/float T/S remain distinct. U02 strength-push count records strict-approved attempt before ordinary move and persists even if position unchanged; no claim of success count. Missing 8 Demo writers and unlocated BP source remain qualified. WP59§5.3.1 retains increment→attempt→snapshot before conditional wait; WP09 retains save prefixes and only save_count rollback; there is no combined all-or-nothing transaction.

Full body keeps four clocks, lazy anchor, 74 fields, seed consumption and recorded-stream boundaries. U01 query update precedes division, S0 unknown remains. U01 two-input RNG normalizes integers/ranges/nil/text without overriding phone20...40 or stateful1/7 sampler; no global unified RNG/sequence promise. U02 diagonal commit increments no distance while generic step and forced-route guards still independently apply; WP12§4.3 and §4.1 align. WP09 time_last_saved can advance anchor before failed save; WP10 migration N/F plus existing-anchor delta remains separate from offline time. Catalog U01-M02-006/007 matches current clauses.

Full body differentiates default collection/export and runtime game/core lookup. U01 replacement removes old game-only Z, append preserves it, default core filters candidates not runtime translations. Key normalization retains internal single LF/value LF and thus is compatible with duplicate-key last-write rules, import line preprocessing and window processing. Recognition source gates precede new K collection; leading-space bracket export counterexample rejects the old odd hash section before evaluating new Q; full compile truncates whereas single-file parse does not. U02 JXN001 consumes selected mutable map-name material after lookup, does not imply all localizations mutate or normal saves persist content. WP11 three reset layers and WP65 saved/global player ordering are aligned; empty language hit does not fall back to core before map basic-name fallback. Cancellation/timeout/partial delete/truncation and native-formatting exception boundaries retained.
